name: img-to-frontend
title_zh: 把任意网页截图变成可直接上线的成品前端
tagline_zh: 别再对着设计稿手搓样式了。丢一张图进来，它替你走完从视觉拆解到响应式布局的全流程，交付的是能跑的代码，不是半成品。
tagline_en: Stop hand-coding from screenshots. Drop in an image, get a production-ready frontend with responsive layout—not a.
desc_en: Use when the user wants an end-to-end premium visual design workflow for any type of website or web page created directly from images.
why_zh: 它把「看图写码」拆成可校验的流水线：先解析视觉层级，再生成组件树，最后套用设计令牌。
why_en: It turns 'code from image' into a verifiable pipeline: visual hierarchy → component tree → design tokens. Each step yields.
limit_zh: 只认静态网页截图，不处理多页交互或复杂动效；输出为 React + Tailwind 代码，无后端集成。
limit_en: Static page screenshots only; no multi-page flows or complex animations. Outputs React + Tailwind, no backend. Blurry text/gradients need manual.
